<content>
*Last updated: 2026-05-15 (end of session). Refresh summary: post-Topograph pivot absorbed (DEC-20260505-D/E/F); v1 scope expanded from 6 fixed countries to \~31 (17 live + 6 mid-rebuild + 8 Gap-8); 11 new vendors added to Vendor Roster; Topograph downgraded from primary multi-country path to customer-funded-only. 2026-05-06 update (DEC-20260506-A): *[*Openapi.com*](http://Openapi.com)* positioning expanded — strong-candidate scope confirmed across all 14 missing-vendor countries (6 mid-rebuild + 8 Gap-8); solid-fallback role added for 5 live-integration countries with overlapping native coverage (FR/UK/BE/CH/PL); best-effort fallback via WW-Start for remaining 11 live integrations. Public pricing-page scan 2026-05-06 confirms PAYG-only direct console with no fixed fee or minimum visible; addendum-specific commercials still pending. Console testing in progress. 2026-05-06 update (DEC-20260506-D): DK Danish CVR circuit breaker manually opened pending quota investigation; half-open auto-probe at T+6h, auto-recovery on first successful probe. 2026-05-06 update (DEC-20260506-G): No-fixed-cost stance adopted for v1 vendor sequencing; DE OpenRegister sequencing tightened (Free tier through v1 launch; Strale100 trial held in reserve; Pro upgrade gated on customer attachment AND audit-retention written confirmation per DEC-20260505-H); AT cheap-tier path affirmed (DEC-20260506-F); Implisense Backup at RapidAPI free Basic affirmed (DEC-20260505-G); bank-verification scoping deferred to separate session pending Magnus Hedenberg meeting (\~May 11). 2026-05-07 update (DEC-20260507-A + DE OpenRegister merge): DE OpenRegister shipped to production (PR #59, merge commit 3d62a4b); brief Class 4 metadata sync incident contained without customer impact (\~90s exposure window before containment, then recovered via programmatic bypass). DE moves from Mid-rebuild to Live; counts shift 17→18 live, 6→5 mid-rebuild. Gap-8 reclassified to Gap-7 per DEC-20260507-A: SK misclassification corrected (free direct REST at *[*api.statistics.sk*](http://api.statistics.sk)* verified); SI and RO bulk paths verified; MT remains genuine gap pending MBR vendor outreach. Course-correction Journal entry filed (six-item unverified-claims pattern). 2026-05-07 update (DEC-20260507-B + DEC-20260507-C, mid-rebuild verification spike): 4-of-5 mid-rebuild paths replaced or adjusted post-spike. NL flips to KVK direct (DEC-20260507-B, pending Swedish-AB eligibility). IT/ES/PT/AT cohort flips to Openapi PAYG (DEC-20260507-C, gated on case 151296 — no build sessions start until that resolves). Concentration risk acknowledged; multi-country aggregator research door kept open as fallback per DEC-20260506-G no-fixed-cost stance. 2026-05-07 update (DEC-20260507-F + DEC-20260507-G + DEC-20260507-H, Kyckr evaluation + gap-recovery spike): Kyckr rejected as multi-country aggregator (standard ToS prohibits redistribution; sales-gated pricing collides with DEC-20260506-G); the multi-country aggregator door is now closed. Gap-recovery spike **`research/gap-recovery-candidates`** (commit 84398f7) verified BG and CY as Tier-1 direct buildable (BG: *[*data.egov.bg*](http://data.egov.bg)* BRRA XML CC-0; CY: *[*data.gov.cy*](http://data.gov.cy)* DRCOR CC-BY confirm-at-ingest). LU and HU remain deferred pending Openapi case 151296 outcome or revenue-justified per-country contracts. Build queue spans 5 countries (SI/SK/RO/BG/CY); MT outreach in flight; LU/HU watchdog filed. 2026-05-07 update (slovak-company-data shipped, branch **`feat/sk-company-data`** commit 790498b, ready for **`/go`**): SK moves Gap-7 → Live; counts shift 18→19 live, build queue 5→4 (SI/RO/BG/CY). DEC-20260507-A is the parent; no new DEC. Smoke 11/11 green; CC-BY 4.0 attribution carried in **`provenance.source`**. Note: Openapi positioning section below is now further out of date (already stale on DE 2026-05-07 ship; now also stale on SK) — bucket reassignment deferred pending case 151296 outcome. 2026-05-07 update (post CC BODS DK audit, no DEC — documentation drift correction): UBO supplement row corrected. OpenOwnership BODS removed from active listing and moved to Held / Downgraded — evaluated 2026-04-02 (**`apps/api/docs/ubo-resolve-uk-bods-evaluation.md`**) and never integrated. Was incorrectly listed in this page's UBO supplement row from DEC-20260430-A canonicalisation through 2026-05-07 audit. See course-correction Journal entry filed same session. 2026-05-08 update (DEC-20260508-B + DEC-20260508-C + DEC-20260508-D): Provenance posture doctrine logged — two-tier model (pointer-to-register where Strale calls registers directly; pointer-to-aggregator-plus-legal-basis where Strale calls aggregators operating under their own legal authority); governs every aggregator without re-deciding each time (DEC-20260508-B). KVK direct rejected for foreign EU entities — Mirjam Boele (Deskaccountmanager Dataverstrekking) confirmed 2026-05-08 that only NL-registered parties can connect to M2M paid Handelsregister APIs; constraint statutory under Handelsregisterwet 2007 + GDPR-grounded internal policy; Datavisie Handelsregister legislation may extend access but usable change is years out (DEC-20260508-C, supersedes the NL eligibility branch of DEC-20260507-B). NL primary intent reverts to *[*Company.info*](http://Company.info)* pending its own redistribution-eligibility validation. OpenRegister audit-retention written answer received and accepted — Pro/Business subscription-bound; Enterprise €1k/mo 6-month minimum for perpetual; Pro path committed in writing as v1 ship target via Strale100 trial; subscription-bound retention accepted as known constraint until Enterprise upgrade keyed to revenue (DEC-20260508-D, resolves the gating condition from DEC-20260505-H). 2026-05-11 update (DEC-20260511-A): NL strategy materially updated following Claude-in-Chrome audit of 8 KVK recognised partners + KVK AV § 3/§ 6 review + KVK partner-becoming page review. Key finding — market default customer ToS for KVK serviceproviders prohibits Strale's API resale model (*[*Company.info*](http://Company.info)* AV: 'het Product ten behoeve van derden te gebruiken of laten gebruiken'; Creditsafe NL AV: 'uitsluitend voor intern gebruik … binnen Nederland', 'mag de Dienst niet opnemen in enig product of dienst dat de Klant verkoopt'). NL row updated to dual-track: CrimiMail as top candidate by elimination (cold outreach sent 2026-05-11) and Strale-applies-for-KVK-recognised-partner-status as parallel investigation (Option B, gated on Mirjam Boele's foreign-EU-scope reply across channels; email sent 2026-05-11). *[*Company.info*](http://Company.info)* downgraded from primary intent to Deferred. PayIBAN / CRMstrategen-Tactick / Leapforce / Handelzeker / CreditDevice rejected as non-data-resellers or wrong product type. Creditsafe NL (incl. Graydon NL, merged) Deferred. Counts unchanged at 20 live + 1 degraded + 5 mid-rebuild + 7 gap. 2026-05-11 update (Openapi verification workstream close, late session): Empirical verification complete across 5 phases, 56 production calls, €4.53 incl 22% IT VAT. Case 151296 resale addendum issued 2026-05-08 (pending Moonlighter AB VAT + countersignature). Mid-rebuild IT/ES/PT/AT pricing corrected from subscription rates (incorrectly cited as canonical previously) to PAYG rates. AT-Start identifier path confirmed as VAT only (FN format returns 406). Six previously-gap countries (BG/CY/HU/LU/MT + partial RO) flip to covered via Openapi WW-Top at THIN-USABLE+ (universal directors=unavailable caveat across all 15 Openapi-served countries). RO is hybrid: post-2002 entities via Openapi WW-Top, pre-2002 long-tail self-build queue retained as v1.1 enhancement. Methodology page v1.0 created in Infrastructure (<mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/35d67c87082c819f9cecd689c6fa5d10"/>). Workstream journals: Phase 2 <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/35d67c87082c81a59bf6d1ba963d5fea"/> ; verification closeout <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/35d67c87082c815aabeac11add30dce4"/> ; Phase 14 closeout <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/35d67c87082c81e584e6f54680b3cefd"/> ; workstream close <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/35d67c87082c810da042f2d768702b55"/> . Counts post-verification: 20 live (incl. DK degraded + SG non-EU) + 4 mid-rebuild via Openapi country-specific endpoints (IT/ES/PT/AT, gated on countersignature) + 1 NL mid-rebuild on independent track + 5 covered via Openapi WW-Top (BG/CY/HU/LU/MT) + 1 hybrid (RO). EU30 specifically: 30 of 30 reachable. 2026-05-12 update (DEC-20260512-A + Openapi case 151296 follow-up): KVK Option B (Strale-applies-for-KVK-recognised-partner-status) closed — Mirjam Boele confirmed 2026-05-11 reply that all KVK channels, including partner status, are closed to foreign EU entities; only Dutch companies eligible, all applications screened by KVK Legal. Supersedes Option B branch of DEC-20260511-A. NL strategy consolidates to CrimiMail outreach (in flight) + BRIS / KVK Open Data Sets last-resort fallback for existence checks. Counts unchanged. Openapi case 151296 follow-up findings: (a) Addendum scope — Shaun De Lucia confirmed 2026-05-11 the addendum covers 'the entire API catalog' subject to legal terms being respected; this does not directly classify UBO Italy / AML Italy under Article 11 (Data Services) vs Article 14 (DD Services), so the Article 14 question remains formally unanswered and those two products should be treated with caution if activated. (b) Italy directors-data path — Shaun clarified 2026-05-12 that only Italy Full returns directors (Italy Advanced returns shareholders only; no other Openapi-served country has directors at any current tier). Italy Full deferred until revenue triggers; the universal directors=unavailable caveat in the Held / Downgraded Openapi entry remains correct for the v1 plan. (c) Vertical endpoints roadmap — Spain, France, Portugal and other countries scheduled for deeper directors+owners integrations starting \~September 2026; tracked as v1.1 enhancement watchpoint. (d) LEI absence on IT-Advanced / FR-Start confirmed as a different upstream supplier per country issue; GLEIF cross-reference remains the recovery path. (e) Openapi WW catalogue reach confirmed at 224 countries; informational, no v1 routing change. 2026-05-12 update (DEC-20260512-A Phase B closeout): Cost-class workstream completed 16:02 UTC. No changes to the active vendor stack — vendors used in the 287-cap classification (Dilisense, Serper, eSortcode, Cobalt, EINsearch, *[*sec-api.io*](http://sec-api.io)*, CourtListener, Bolagsverket, CBE wrapper, Sudreg, GEMI, plus non-CA vendors Kadaster BAG, EP-Online, GitHub API, PageSpeed) are already documented above or are non-CA capabilities outside this page's CA-product scope. Per-vendor quota caps now declared in code as authoritative cost_class metadata. Vendor Roster cost_class metadata hygiene tracked as separate small task. Counts unchanged. Closeout journal: <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/35e67c87082c81479fe3dbcb4537e556"/> 2026-05-13 update (DEC-20260513-B + DEC-20260513-C + DEC-20260513-D): three vendor-state events resolved in one session. (a) CH **`swiss-company-data`** — the earlier-session 'Zefix free tier returns cancelled-only' diagnosis was wrong; manifest's **`known_answer.input.uid`** (CHE-105.805.977) was not a real Swiss UID. Fixture corrected to CHE-101.602.521 (Roche Holding AG, ACTIVE) in PR #107; manual breaker pin set 09:37Z released 10:23Z same day. CH back to live. (b) SK **`slovak-company-data`** — Phase 1 'structural rate limit Strale can't engineer around' diagnosis was wrong in shape; the saturation was Strale's own scheduler firing 5 test suites simultaneously on the **`:41`** tick. Per-suite hash-stagger shipped globally in PR #108; SK breaker auto-recovered 10:41Z; verification probe 11:01Z returned populated SEXES spol. s r. o. data. Scheduler-spread also serves as partial Phase 3 Harden for burst-saturation pattern. (c) DK **`danish-company-data`** — incidentally observed to have auto-recovered between 2026-05-06 and 2026-05-11 (precise timestamp not preserved); DEC-20260506-D superseded by DEC-20260513-D; planned outreach to the Danish registry keeper now moot; Degraded section removed below. Counts unchanged at 20 live. Phase 2 Understand journal pending (covers the trust-in-pipeline blind spot and the cascade of misdiagnosis). Phase 3 Harden gates named: canonical-input sentinel test + pipeline-bypass detector. 2026-05-13 update (DEC-20260513-F + PR #116, v1 Identity audit closeout): v1 Identity coverage audit complete; residuals closed. All 20 shipped Identity capabilities (19 EU30 + SG) audit-verified v1-ready end-to-end via canonical-input validation + end-to-end execution + 24h canary green-rate confirmation for DK and DE (both 6/6 = 100% at audit time per DEC-20260512-A free_quota gate). GR fixture corrected via PR #116 (branch entity → HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings SA parent, **`gemi_number 296601000`**, 11 directors with roles + **`industry_code 19200000`** populated). The verdict covers the 20 shipped Identity capabilities only — the 10 Openapi-pending countries (IT/ES/PT/AT mid-rebuild + BG/CY/HU/LU/MT + RO post-2002 via WW-Top) and NL remain gated on external dependencies (Openapi addendum countersignature + CrimiMail outreach respectively). SI structural source-gap disclosure logged per the DEC (status/regdate/NACE/directors absent in **`data.gov.si`** CKAN). Counts unchanged at 20 live + 4 mid-rebuild via Openapi country-specific endpoints (IT/ES/PT/AT) + 1 NL mid-rebuild on independent track + 5 covered via Openapi WW-Top (BG/CY/HU/LU/MT) + 1 hybrid (RO). Sentinel test (Phase 3 Harden gate (a)) and pipeline-bypass detector (gate (b)) queued as follow-ups. 2026-05-13 update (VIES UK-GB coverage verification, late session — no DEC, documentation drift correction): empirical verification (findings doc **`apps/api/docs/vies-uk-gb-coverage-verification-2026-05-13.md`**) refuted the prior "VIES covers EU27 + UK" claim. VIES rejects GB at country-code level (**`INVALID_INPUT`**); XI remains in VIES; HMRC Check a UK VAT Number API v2.0 is the sole programmatic path for GB. Strale code (**`vat-validate.ts`**) already routes GB → HMRC and EU27+XI → VIES — correction is canonical-surface only. v1 stack global legs table updated in this session to split the VAT row into two. HMRC sandbox integration verified 2026-05-13 (**`apps/api/docs/hmrc-sandbox-test-report-2026-05-13.md`**); production credentials in flight via support ref 2026-CNS433. 2026-05-15 update (DEC-20260515-A, US v1 scope upgrade): US registry/EIN/litigation capabilities upgraded from v1.1 to v1 launch scope. Cobalt = **`vendor`** (Tier 2) provenance; direct state SOS APIs = **`primary`** (Tier 1), consistent with Openapi and OpenRegister precedent (call topology drives the tier, not data content). Topograph 14-state catalog adopted as blueprint for direct-build evaluation (CO/DE/FL/GA/IL/MA/MN/NV/NJ/NY/PA/TX/WA/WY); per-state free-path audit determines which qualify under the no-material-cost gate; Cobalt covers the gap (36 non-Topograph states plus any Topograph state failing the gate). Cobalt sign-up posture: PAYG (no annual commit; revisit post-launch if volume justifies). US bank verification remains v1.2 per structural regulatory gap (no PAYG-friendly vendor; CoP-equivalent infrastructure does not exist in US). Partial supersession of DEC-20260430-A US v1.1 designation; all other DEC-20260430-A elements stand. Counts unchanged for EU+UK+NO+CH live count (20); US adds a separate footprint dimension tracked in the v1 stack — US table below. Sign-ups to complete: Cobalt, EINsearch, *[*sec-api.io*](http://sec-api.io)*, Docket Alarm, CourtListener creds. 2026-05-15 update (DK handler routing verification — no DEC, documentation drift correction): the Nordics DK identity source was canonically labeled "CVR" implying Virk direct integration. Empirical verification 2026-05-15 (handler at **`apps/api/src/capabilities/danish-company-data.ts:10`** declares **`const CVR_API = "https://cvrapi.dk/api"`**; handler self-declares **`upstream_vendor: "cvrapi.dk"`** + **`acquisition_method: "vendor_aggregation"`**; no CVR/Virk env-var declared anywhere in **`apps/api`**) confirms DK has always routed through the *[*cvrapi.dk*](http://cvrapi.dk)* free tier (third-party wrapper, Tier-2). Findings doc **`apps/api/docs/dk-handler-routing-2026-05-15.md`** on **`docs/identity-field-coverage-2026-05-15`** commit **`0fb7632`**. *[*cvrapi.dk*](http://cvrapi.dk)* free tier is subject to IP-based daily throttling per their own docs (**`QUOTA_EXCEEDED`** returns when exceeded, resets next day) — observed empirically in the 2026-05-15 identity field-coverage audit Batch 2. Active Vendor Stack DK row split out of Nordics into a new Tier-2 wrapper row in the live-production table below. Migration to Virk system-til-system direct integration tracked as Journal risk entry (<mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/36167c87082c819ea49fcaa96e42833a"/>) and three To-do items including the Petter-owned access application email to Erhvervsstyrelsen (\~3-week processing time). Same pattern as the 2026-05-07 BODS documentation drift correction and the 2026-05-13 VIES UK-GB documentation drift correction. Counts unchanged at 20 live (the capability is still in production; only the canonical labeling changes from Tier-1 to Tier-2). \[SUPERSEDED 2026-05-17: canonical-surface references in the following entry — "Provider-Coverage matrix at 34867c87…", "the canonical Provider-Coverage matrix" — are stale; the matrix migrated to **`apps/api/coverage-matrix/`** in repo per DEC-20260517-A. See the 2026-05-17 entries below for current state.\] 2026-05-16 update (BR coverage code-side complete): 4 Openapi-resolver PRs landed (#121 Phase 1 AT template at 12ab156, #122 Phase 2a 7 WW-Top countries at ef25d42, #123 Phase 2b ES+PT *-Advanced at 2a041ab, #124 Phase 2c IT-Advanced at ab330cc) plus PR #120 schema cleanup for 6 functional countries (UK/IE/EE/LV/PL/FI, merged fd59571). The 11 Openapi-routed countries (AT/BG/CY/HU/LU/MT/NL/RO + ES/PT + IT) now have shipped code-side capabilities behind double-gating (OPENAPI_ENABLED=false env + is_active=false DB), pending Openapi resale addendum countersignature on case 151296 for production traffic activation. Status doctrine resolved 2026-05-16 (canonical in Provider-Coverage DB header): Live=serving production traffic; Committed=code-ready + smoke-tested + double-gated awaiting commercial/operator unblock. Per this doctrine, all 11 Openapi-routed countries flipped from Live to Committed in Provider-Coverage matrix. Tables below reflect pre-doctrine state; canonical per-country routing lives in Provider-Coverage matrix at 34867c87-082c-8187-9391-ebc05a9b3d90 (BR Coverage Matrix v1 view). Phase 2c also defined StraleShareHolder shape contract — IT-Advanced is first v1 capability returning shareholders; v1.1+ enrichments (UK PSC, IT-Full managers, UBO-Italy) conform to this shape. v1.1 deferrals: IT-Full async architecture (managers/subsidiaries closure for IT directors), UBO-Italy product, ES direct Registradores integration, PT direct Registo Comercial integration, check-tier-coverage.mjs CI gate (Phase 1 WARN-ONLY in flight). VAT-flip trigger pending Moonlighter AB VAT confirmation: 8 WW-Top manifests flip price_cents 16→13, 2 *-Advanced flip 6→5, 1 IT-Advanced flips 12→10. Counts: 19 functional Live + 11 Openapi-routed Committed = 30 EU30 code-side complete. 2026-05-17 update (fresh-context audit + Notion drift cleanup, no new DEC): A fresh-context audit run from a new chat with code-side ground truth via git clone of cb305b0 caught accumulated drift the in-session audits missed. Two follow-up PRs merged 2026-05-17: PR #125 (check-tier-coverage.mjs CI gate Phase 1 WARN-ONLY at 1888b0c; 33 captured fixtures; 8 grandfathered slugs in allowlist; gate exits 0 in Phase 1) and PR #126 (manifest-drift cleanup at cb305b0; declared CH legal_form_id + UK jurisdiction/sic_codes/has_charges; allowlist 10→8). The check-tier-coverage gate is no longer a v1.1 deferral — it shipped Phase 1 WARN-ONLY; Phase 2 STRICT promotion remains queued pending review of the remaining 8 grandfathered allowlist slugs (brazilian/estonian/french/japanese/norwegian/polish/swedish/us). PR #117 (canonical-input sentinel test, Phase 3 Harden gate (a)) confirmed merged earlier; pipeline-bypass detector (gate (b)) remains queued. Provider-Coverage matrix corrections landed in same session (see Provider-Coverage DB header for full list): CZ slug fix czech-company-data → cz-company-data (NOTION_AHEAD closed), 8 additional Tier-1-violation scraper rows flipped Status=Live → Deprecated bringing total to 11 not 3 (DE/NL northdata, IE *[*core.cro.ie*](http://core.cro.ie)*, IT *[*registroimprese.it*](http://registroimprese.it)*, AT *[*finapu.com*](http://finapu.com)*, BE KBO, LV *[*info.ur.gov.lv*](http://info.ur.gov.lv)*, ES *[*empresia.es*](http://empresia.es)*), Provider doctrine resolved to vendor-naming (4 new Provider enum options added — *[*cvrapi.dk*](http://cvrapi.dk)*, *[*cbeapi.be*](http://cbeapi.be)*, Sudreg, Zefix; 8 row corrections), Cost per call (Strale) column aligned to manifest price_cents across 22 rows (11 Openapi rows reverted from post-VAT-flip target to pre-flip; 11 free-direct rows normalized to €0.05), AT Doctrine reword to 'Moonlighter AB VAT issuance (via Skatteverket)', DK + NL Provider ToS notes cleaned of pre-Openapi-pivot framing, EE/LV/IE/FI Notes refreshed acknowledging PR #120 merged. New process rule in force this session: every Notion write followed by fetch-back verify (failure mode that produced today's 22-row Cost drift). Tables below still reflect pre-2026-05-16-doctrine state — full narrative-table refresh deferred to a focused brand-voice session; canonical per-country state lives in the Provider-Coverage matrix. Late-afternoon 2026-05-17 update (Provider-Coverage matrix migration shipped per DEC-20260517-A, already filed earlier this session): Migration from Notion to **`apps/api/coverage-matrix/`** complete via PR #127 merged at 16:18Z UTC, main HEAD now at commit 5433268. 46 YAML files generated under the (capability_slug, country, evidence_type) primary key (corrected from initial (slug, country) after v2 halt surfaced uk-company-data multi-evidence-type case). Notion Provider-Coverage matrix DB renamed to "⚠️ ARCHIVED 2026-05-17 — Provider-Coverage matrix (canonical → apps/api/coverage-matrix/)" and retained read-only for 30 days per DEC-A before trash. Chat-side update protocol locked via Working Rule J + DEC-20260517-B; chat has no direct write path to repo reference data — changes route through CC-prompt artifacts. Mid-rebuild and Previously-gap tables in body rewritten to pointer paragraphs in same session, pointing to canonical state at **`apps/api/coverage-matrix/COVERAGE.md`**. Live-in-production table kept as region overview (stable categorization, low drift risk). Global-legs / Bank-verification / Litigation / US tables kept as operational reference. Held / Downgraded + Rejected vendors + Re-evaluation triggers sections kept as vendor-narrative context. 12 empty-slug Live/Committed rows in pre-migration Notion logged for separate triage (inconsistent records: Status implied "ready" but slug was unassigned). 2026-05-18 update (DEC-20260518-A/B/C/D/E/F + EE binding-ready ship + 3-of-3 blocker reversals): six DECs filed governing v1 BR ship shape and data-sourcing posture. DEC-20260518-A canonicalises the customer-facing Evidence Tier framework (T1 Identity / T2 Bindability / T3 Ownership). DEC-20260518-E mandates 8-path enumeration before any country is classified "no free path" or "paid-only" — triggered by Phase 2/3 sessions classifying HR + EE + BE as blocked after only first-path failure; subsequent enumeration reversed 3 of 3. DEC-20260518-F clarifies DEC-20260428-A scope: targeted per-call HTML/PDF parsing of statutorily-public registry detail pages is in-scope when 4 constraints hold (statutorily public, ToS permits per-call, per-entity per-customer-request, attribution preserved); rules out bulk-scraping architecture which remains off-limits. EE binding-ready T2 shipped via PR #139 (RIK Ariregister Open Data bulk JSON **`kaardile_kantud_isikud`**, daily refresh, CC BY 4.0, attribution preserved per DEC-20260518-F constraint d; nightly Railway cron ingests into **`ee_directors`** Postgres table; smoke confirmed 2 active board members for Bolt Technology OÜ). T2 8/30 binding-ready post-PR-139 (DE/GR/FR/SK/UK/NO/CZ + EE); LV PR #134 + IT PR #135 pending. BE reclassified from "paid subscription" to "prepaid topup €0.025/call" — Phase 3 misread the €50/2k SOAP fee as monthly subscription; FPS Economy own wording confirms prepaid topup (no recurrence, no expiry), passthrough-compatible per cost directive; procurement in flight Petter-owned (€50 wire + 7-day activation). HR remains v1.1 deferral — Topograph €1,500/mo platform fee DQ re-confirmed against the public docs claim of "no minimum commitments"; institutional learning logged (RFQ-only vendors require platform-fee probe per Journal 35967c87082c8177 before any per-call viability classification, applicable to all remaining Phase 4/5/6/7b enumeration). SE Phase 4 partial correction: **`foretradare_historik.csv`** is aggregate-only statistics about representatives (age/gender breakdowns), not named officers per organization number; the HVD API (**`apierochoppnadata/vardefulladatamangder`**, free per Bolagsverket's own "avgiftsfritt och utan avtal" framing, EU Implementing Regulation 2023/138 mandates representative content for the "Companies and company ownership" HVD category) is the actual v1 candidate pending targeted probe. DK CVR S2S contract follow-up sent to **`cvrselvbetjening@erst.dk`** (no reply to original \~3-week-old application). Realistic launch target 11-14/30 v1 binding-ready T2 post Phase 4+5 closeout (SE/PL/LT joined HR on v1.1 deferred list), contingent on remaining Phase 6 (MT+CY+HU+LU) + Phase 7b (NL+ES+AT) enumeration outcomes. ## How to read this page
**Source-of-truth precedence (Rule 13 of How this workspace works):**
1. **Decisions DB** — authoritative for any vendor status change. Immutable; superseded only by a new Decision.
2. **Counterparty Assurance — Capability × Country Coverage Matrix** — canonical doctrine page for the post-Topograph architecture; vendor assignments per (capability × country) come from here.
3. **Vendor Roster (Vendor Evaluation Log)** — every vendor ever evaluated, with current status and rationale. Operational view; row status follows Decisions.
4. **This page** — derived narrative view of the Roster filtered to Status = Active or in active rebuild. The canonical "what are we using right now" answer.
5. **`apps/api/coverage-matrix/`** (repo YAML, canonical per DEC-20260517-A) — runtime routing per (capability_slug, country, evidence_type). Updates via Working Rule J CC-prompt protocol. The pre-migration Notion DB at 34867c87-082c-8187-9391-ebc05a9b3d90 is archived (read-only 30 days from 2026-05-17, then trashed).
If any of those disagree, the higher one wins for **narrative content** (vendor names, status rationale, ToS notes, rejection reasons). For **runtime routing data** (provider field, price_cents, status enum, tier coverage flags, evidence grade), `apps/api/coverage-matrix/` is the canonical runtime source regardless of position in this list — Decisions DB still wins on the underlying status decision, but the per-row YAML is the runtime truth. Update the lower-priority surfaces in the same session you discover drift.
**What the tier coverage flags mean** — the Evidence Tier framework (DEC-20260518-A) defines what fields constitute Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3 coverage at the customer-facing contract level. Canonical at <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/36367c87082c8146870eee51af40d886"/>. The per-yaml tier coverage flags are scored against that framework. Do not conflate with the Vendor Roster Data Sourcing Tier system (Tier 1 Strale-built / Tier 2 vendor-mediated / Tier 3 licensed bulk), which is a separate dimension.
**Reading repo reference data from chat** — canonical surface routing for chat-side READS of `apps/api/coverage-matrix/` and capability handlers is at <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/36367c87082c8191b62acde1650298b1"/>. Rule J governs writes; that page governs reads.

2. Customer or regulator requires Strale-controlled dataset replay (Merkle-rooted)
3. 12 months elapsed (April 2027)
4. Dilisense initiates upgrade conversation OR materially changes terms
**Vendor stack as a whole (per DEC-20260430-A):**
A new vendor enters consideration only on a documented signal: founder reachout, public pricing change, discontinuation of an Active vendor, or a customer ask the existing stack can't serve. Passage of time alone is not a re-evaluation trigger. Do not re-open Movitz, Banfico, MonitorPay, Middesk, Persona, GovLink, etc. without such a signal.
**Topograph (per DEC-20260505-E):**
Re-engages only if: customer-funded contract; platform fee waived/ramp-deferred; fee credited against usage; or coverage exclusivity strong enough to justify fixed cost.
